component.name: Icefin Player
component.summary: Themeable Jellyfin client for the desktop and the living room

description.p: Icefin Player plays media from a Jellyfin server using the server's own web interface and mpv. It adds themes, HDR output, HDMI audio passthrough and controller support, and is built for Linux and Wayland.
Icefin Player is an independent fork of jellyfin-desktop and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Jellyfin project.

Feedback on the first alpha: Client Settings as a themed page that works with a controller, a connecting dialog and error notice for Live TV, skip buttons kept clear of the player controls, player controls sized for 4K and a Couch Mode, theme sounds that play when desktop notification sounds are muted, and Plaza fixes.

First alpha: the theme engine with Media Center and eleven layout themes, the Vulkan renderer with HDR output, HDMI audio passthrough with receiver detection, SDL3 controllers and in-app diagnostics, on jellyfin-desktop 2.0.0. Tested in a virtual lab; not yet on testers' hardware.
